name: @dsh-trading/indicator-supertrend
description: SPIKE (community-indicator example, 2026-08-30): third-party technical indicator plugin proving the tradingIndicators service channel — injects the service and registers a Supertrend (超级趋势) definition. ATR is implemented locally (zero runtime dependency on @dsh-trading/indicators); types are type-only imports. Not wired into any bundle: mounted by a profile-level cordis.patch.yml row, emulating how a real community plugin joins.
